title: Parallel Paradise
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High schooler Youta Tada is attacked by a strange creature and wakes in a fantasy world of castles, dragons and two moons where he is the first man in centuries. Women there have no resistance to his touch, and a bird claiming to be God orders him to mate with them. The ongoing erotic fantasy, published in English under Seven Seas' mature Ghost Ship imprint, mixes explicit sex with a darker mystery about the world's women.
life_message: The story treats male sexual power over women as the hero's gift and pleasure as the main reward.
